pages.text:
Two unpowered machines of treated wood, copper and iron that work the 3x3 of crops in front of them. Place one facing the field; it works its own level and the one below, so it can stand on the ground beside raised farmland or on the farmland's level.
- With a redstone signal wired to it, it runs once on each pulse.
- With no redstone next to it, it runs every 5 seconds by itself.

Planter: holds 9 stacks of seeds. Use it with seeds to put them in; sneak-use with an empty hand to take them back. Each run it plants a seed on every empty farmland in front of it: wheat, beetroot, carrots, potatoes, melon and pumpkin seeds, Flax, Rapeseed and Sorghum. Hop Seeds go into a bare Trellis standing on farmland. Hoppers and conduits can fill it from any side.

Harvester: harvests every ripe crop in front of it into its 18 slots and replants each one with a seed from its own harvest. A Trellis bearing Hop Cones has them picked and keeps its vine. Use it with an empty hand to take the harvest, or pull it out with a hopper or conduit. A crop whose harvest won't fit is left standing.
Areas and the timer are in the config (farming.cropProcessing.rusticMachines).
